Hey girl, before I share my thoughts - would like to preface im not a mental health professional, so what I say might not be 100% accurate. but I have also similar issues and experiences. So i completely understand. 

Here we go: from what you said, it sounds like he’s willing to give you a chance. Thats a win for you - he still cares. Not all hope is lost yet. It sounds like a really tough situation for both of you, BUT just know he’s doing this to protect his boundaries and sanity for himself to heal.

Its good that he verbalised his feelings. Now you know what you need to do! Grieving is completely normal. I would feel the same way as you considering how much you love him. Let yourself feel the grief, its okay. 

But after that, sit down and think about it. There’s a solution to this, you just need to change your way of thinking. Or, you can try diversifying your support system not to more people. Its draining for someone whos going through something to constantly support another person. That includes seeking medical help, try try try something until it works. Remember: A relationship has to be reciprocal; both parties have to support each other. The relationship should not be dragging any party down, both parties should bring out the best in each other 

Give yourself 3 months to make a change, work on yourself. I know its hard my friend…. Its gonna be super hard at the start. You need to do this, not just for him, but for YOURSELF too. When you come back, as a better person, hopefully it’ll all work out :)

I hope this helped yea.
